findings.summary: The -- exemption in limit_of leaks onto non-measure commands, reopening the false-green hole #33 closes
findings.evidence: low-coverage --fail-on-coverage exits 0 with a silent default; only 3 of 8 call sites carry the measure-only doctrine.
findings.fix: Split into limit_of (strict) and measure_limit_of (exempt), scope to the 3 measure commands.

findings.summary: (function, module) dedup key lets a bare and scoped record for the same function collide in phase 2 with a misleading diagnosis
findings.evidence: Two records for 'dup' (bare + module-qualified) resolve to one function_id, hit UNIQUE(function_id, recorded_at), report 'run again in a moment' which cannot help.
findings.fix: Reject a bare+scoped mix for one name in phase 1.

findings.summary: #34's status<>'done' is NULL-blind, so a NULL-status task still vanishes
findings.evidence: gardening_tasks.status has a DEFAULT but no NOT NULL; a NULL row is absent from both 'open' and 'log'.

findings.summary: The ratchet's own comment about which call sites die exit 3 first is factually wrong, leaving half the reachable commands untested
findings.evidence: god-modules/low-coverage/dead-blocks reach limit_of on the test fixture (has_table only checks existence); only useless-branches/mutation-density die 3 first.
findings.fix: Correct the comment, extend coverage to the reachable commands.

findings.summary: Pre-existing sibling of #33's bug in a different file, unfixed
findings.evidence: Identical silent-default-on-garbage limit parse shape as arch_query.ml had before #33.
findings.fix: Factor #33's hardened parse out and reuse; filed separately as issue #47, not fixed on this branch (no issue named this file).
findings.check_encodable_reason: Pre-existing bug in a file none of #33/#34/#35 named — fixing it here would be scope creep mid-branch. Filed as issue #47 for a fast follow-up instead of a ratchet check on this branch.
